thread:
Maya: Quick check-in 1: final blog draft for the feature launch is in the doc: https://docs.google.com/example. Planning to go live Thu 4/1 @ 11am PT and run a webinar 4/8 @ 10am PT. Need final on copy, benchmark claims, hero image, UTMs, and the webinar registration flow.

Jon: I'm on copy review. I'll focus on the hero headline and lead paragraph. Any constraints from legal/product?

Priya: Legal note: avoid "best" or direct competitor callouts. Use "internal testing" and include a short methodology link and a disclaimer about workload variance. No customer names without signed approval.

Luis: Benchmarks: we measured redwood-4x on a standard text-complete workload, 2k context. I can confirm p95 and cost delta but need to pull the latest run.

Maya: Draft currently says "p95 <120ms and 30% cheaper vs baseline." If we can lock on numbers, fine, otherwise reword to "~118ms p95; up to 28% lower inference cost (internal testing)."

Jon: That wording sounds safer. I'll update the lead to: "Based on internal testing, we observed p95 latency of ~118ms and up to 28% lower inference cost on redwood-4x (2k context). See methodology."

Rachel: For hero options I can provide two variants: 1) compact performance chart 2) UI screenshot with annotations. Which should we default to for socials?

Ben: For CRO/UTM: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=feature-launch-apr2026, utm_content=chart|ui. Recommend inline reg form above the fold for webinar sign-ups to maximize conversion.

Maya: Sales routing: route to HubSpot list "inbound-webinar-apr-2026", tag source=blog. SDR queue gets initial outreach unless lead_score>35 then AE. Ben can set HubSpot form fields.

Ben: I'll create the form and pipeline. Need final utm_content value and the webinar event slug. Also will set a hidden field for campaign.

Luis: Confirmed numbers in the bench sheet: p95=118ms, cost delta=28% vs our baseline config. Methodology link: https://internal.example.com/benchmarks/redwood-4x-2026. Use the phrase "based on internal testing" and add the footnote.

Priya: Approved language with the footnote: "Results depend on workload and configuration; see methodology." Also flag: include privacy scrubbing note for screenshots.

Rachel: Uploaded hero mocks to Figma: https://figma.com/file/example-hero. Variant A=chart, Variant B=screenshot (sensitive fields blurred). Will export PNGs for the post.

Jon: Updated the doc with headline options and intro. My pick: "Ship real-time LLM features with predictable latency and lower inference cost." Feedback?

Maya: That headline is fine. Let's A/B test CTA copy: "Save your seat" vs "Register now". Which one in ad creative?

Ben: Use "Save your seat" for organic + email, "Register now" for paid. I'll add utm_content accordingly.

Maya: Great. If no other blockers I'm going to lock design/copy at 5pm today and schedule publish. Please ping me if legal or product needs changes before then.

Luis: No blockers from engineering. Numbers confirmed.

Priya: Legal sign-off pending the final methodology link and the screenshot blur confirmation.

Rachel: Blurs applied and file updated.

Maya: Thanks everyone 1 I'll update the doc with final UTMs, the AE two-line outreach + one stat (for Sales), and schedule the publish. :rocket:
